list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY build_version

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_name, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('session_started','session_ended','run_started','run_completed','floor_completed')) GROUP BY event_name LIMIT 1000

SELECT count() AS encounters, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome')='win') / greatest(count(),1) AS win_rate FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed') LIMIT 1000

SELECT JSONExtractInt(properties,'floor') AS floor, count() AS completions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='floor_completed') GROUP BY floor LIMIT 1000
